reasoning: The agent maintained a genuine, dependency-aware sequence (parsers/model → layout → serialization → alignment → CLI) and tied each component grouping to specific parity tests as done-checks, clearly exceeding anchor 5. But it fell short of anchor 8's explicit, crisply-defined milestone set: the plan was repetitive rolling prose that drifted into 'implement all remaining stubs,' no structured tracking was used, and — unlike anchor 10 — the most parity-sensitive pieces (edge layout, BIF drain zones) were left to the end rather than de-risked early, with the mid-trajectory dominated by reactive compilation fixes. This places observed behavior at 6, between the 5 and 8 anchors.
